CV.fold_assignment: per-class rank mod4, consistent B8 subset B16
CV.selection: pooled correct count over all original out-of-fold predictions

augmentation_seed: SHA256(salt|geometry or randaugment|decoded RGB SHA256|view0..3), first64bits masked to63; CPU Torch fork_rng
clean: PIL RGB; bicubic resize shorter256; center crop224
clean_view_compression: four identical clean views represented by one encoder feature then exactly replicated for ridge
diagnostic: CV ranking vs mean four fold-model query accuracy vs full-fit query ranking, same tie order; not pure causal decomposition
feature: final layernorm CLS384, per-view unit L2
limits: correlated query land patches and overlapping supports; no independent-scene or independence claim
fixed ridge and 4 Monte Carlo views only
no thresholds demanding 1 or2pp; no effect-based stopping
not CLAP/FroFA reproduction or novel theory
mandatory: all fixed strategies, both budgets, every episode; harmful frequency separately vs weak/RA; posthoc best regret only diagnostic
primary_metrics: selected minus weak full-fit query accuracy
selected minus RA full-fit query accuracy
query_gate: all 360 heads and 24 CV choices sealed before query extraction/evaluation

ridge.objective: mean_original mean_view squared residual + lambda Frobenius squared W
